title: Inventory Tracking info icon shows the tracking help text
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • No part is saved in this case.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part.
  2. Hover the mouse over the info icon beside the Inventory Tracking heading.
  3. Read the text that appears, word for word.
  4. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: A tooltip appears next to the info icon.
  • Step 3: It reads exactly: "Tracked parts keep a stock count, with Min and Max. Turn this off for items you don't count. Untracked parts are left out of the Inventory Value report." All three sentences must be there; if the last sentence, about the Inventory Value report, is missing, the case fails.
  • Step 4: The dialog closes and no part is created.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S4-R3, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 5.1 (The Inventory Tracking section) and tracking-note-0, which now show all three sentences, 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).
